assets.name: clouds
assets.prompt: Create a production-ready transparent RGBA game sprite atlas, wide landscape canvas 2048 by 1024, 2 columns and 2 rows, four SEPARATE thick cumulus cloud banks, each isolated within its own equal cell with at least 10 percent completely transparent padding at all cell edges. Native transparent alpha background, never a checkerboard drawing, never black or grey background. Each cloud bank wider than tall, voluminous overlapping rounded lobes and fine wispy edges, painterly realism for a premium moody alpine forest 2D game. Substantial opaque ivory-silver cores, soft steel-blue undersides, pale neutral lit top edges, layered sculpted cloud volume, restrained detailed brushwork, diffuse midday light. The four banks have DIFFERENT asymmetric silhouettes, different billowing lobes and long ragged tails. No landscape, no horizon, no mountains, no sun, no sky color background, no lens flare, no particles, no text, no cell dividers. All four assets must float separately on true transparent pixels. These are cloud cutout assets to animate and tint dynamically with game weather, not complete scenery paintings.

assets.name: celestial
assets.prompt: Create a production-ready transparent RGBA game sprite atlas, wide canvas 1536 by 768 with 2 equal square cells in one row. LEFT CELL: one beautiful warm ivory SUN seen through clear air, round bright ivory disc diameter approximately 210 pixels centered at x384 y384, delicate textured gold limb, very subtle solar granulation only at outer limb, smooth luminous atmospheric aureole extending approximately 290 pixels from center and fading completely into transparent alpha. Elegant soft physically plausible light bloom, no spiky rays, no icon styling, no orange fireball. RIGHT CELL: one beautiful cool silver waxing gibbous MOON centered at x1152 y384, disc diameter approximately 180 pixels, natural crater/mare texture, shaded charcoal terminator on left, restrained soft cool blue aureole fading completely into transparency at radius 200px. Premium softly painted realism matching a moody mountain forest 2D game. These are two separate sky body sprites for a dynamic day and night cycle. Large true transparent margins around each and between them. Native transparent alpha background, NOT a checkerboard drawing, NOT black or grey background. No stars, no clouds, no landscapes, no text, no frame, no cell dividers. Individual discs fully round and readable. The glow alpha fades smoothly, no bounding-box edges.
